newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index falls 3.17 pct, led by PLDT.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index falls 3.17 pct, led by PLDT.

text.p: The Philippine share index fell 82.17 points, or 3.17 percent, to 2,507.03 points in early trade on Thursday on follow-through selling brought about by concerns on the peso, brokers said.

"It's a bloodbath. Everything I see is red. There's a lot of concern on the currency and foreign funds are into the U.S. and European markets," said Teresa Lee, vice-president at Asiamerit Securities.
PLDT fell 70 pesos, or 7.87 percent, to 820 pesos in early session. After only eight minutes of trade, the index fell 108.38 points, or 4.19 percent to 2,480.82.
